column1: # Every value the bundler freezes into the dashboard's bundles, and where upstream's hosted
# values remain. Gate 70-public holds it. Tab-separated:
#   NAME  TEXT     a name of the bundler's resolved replacement map (define, in every
#                  environment) and the replacement text it is given
#                  a value of upstream's pinned .env that the build finds in the bundle file
#                  FILE (a bundler hash written [hash]): named by file and name, never by value
# No plain row may hold a value of upstream's .env. A patch that changes what is frozen
# changes these rows in the same commit.
